trot.definition:
n. a gait faster than a walk; diagonally opposite legs strike the ground together
v. run at a moderately swift pace
v. ride at a trot
v. cause to trot
trot.translation:
n. 快步
vi. 快步走, 小跑
vt. 使小跑, 策马小跑

trot in double harness.translation: 结婚,完婚;比翼双飞,夫唱妻随

trot out.translation: 炫耀地出示, 骑马快步跑给人看, 提出...供赞同

troteer's syndrome.translation: [医] 特罗特氏综合征(鼻咽部恶性瘤)

troth.definition:
n a mutual promise to marry
n a solemn pledge of fidelity
troth.translation:
n. 忠诚, 真实, 诚实, 诺言
vt. 约定, 订婚

trothless.translation: a. <古>不忠诚的,不忠实的, 背信弃义的

trothplight.definition:
v. t. To betroth.
a. Betrothed; espoused; affianced.
n. The act of betrothing, or plighting faith; betrothing.
trothplight.translation: <古>n.(尤指婚姻的)誓约, 订婚

trothplighted.translation:
[古语]
n. 订婚
a. 订了婚的

troths.translation: 誓言( troth的第三人称单数 )

trotline.definition: n a long fishing line with many shorter lines and hooks attached to it (usually suspended between buoys)

trotman.translation: [人名] [英格兰人、苏格兰人姓氏] 特罗特曼 Trotter的变体

trots.definition:
n a slow pace of running
n radicals who support Trotsky's theory that socialism must be established throughout the world by continuing revolution
n a literal translation used in studying a foreign language (often used illicitly)
n a gait faster than a walk; diagonally opposite legs strike the ground together
v run at a moderately swift pace
v ride at a trot
v cause to trot
trots.translation:
n. 小跑, 急走( trot的名词复数 ); 匆匆忙忙地走
v. 小跑, 急走( trot的过去式 ); 匆匆忙忙地走

trotsky.definition: n. Russian revolutionary and Communist theorist who helped Lenin and built up the army; he was ousted from the Communist Party by Stalin and eventually assassinated in Mexico (1879-1940)
trotsky.translation: n. 托洛茨基（前苏联托洛茨基集团领袖, 后被开除出党）

trotskyism.definition: n. the form of communism advocated by Leon Trotsky; calls for immediate worldwide revolution by the proletariat

trotskyist.definition: n radicals who support Trotsky's theory that socialism must be established throughout the world by continuing revolution
trotskyist.translation: n. 托洛斯基分子, 托派分子

trotskyists.definition: n. radicals who support Trotsky's theory that socialism must be established throughout the world by continuing revolution
trotskyists.translation:
n. 托洛茨基分子, 托派分子
a. 托洛茨基分子的, 托派分子的；托洛茨基主义的[亦作 Trotskyite ／-ait／]

trotskyite.definition: n. radicals who support Trotsky's theory that socialism must be established throughout the world by continuing revolution
trotskyite.translation: n. 托洛茨基分子, 托派分子

trotskyites.definition: n. radicals who support Trotsky's theory that socialism must be established throughout the world by continuing revolution
trotskyites.translation:
n. 托洛茨基或托洛茨基主义的支持者
a. 托洛茨基的；托洛茨基主义的[亦作 Trotskyist]

trotted.translation: v. 小跑, 急走( trot的过去分词 ); 匆匆忙忙地走

trotter.definition: n. foot of a pig or sheep especially one used as food
trotter.translation: n. 小跑步的马, 快步走的人, 猪脚, (谑)脚

trotternish.translation: [地名] [英国] 特罗特尼什半岛

trotters.definition:
n. foot of a pig or sheep especially one used as food
n. a horse trained to trot; especially a horse trained for harness racing
trotters.translation: n. 快跑的马( trotter的复数形式 )

trotting.definition:
v run at a moderately swift pace
v ride at a trot
v cause to trot
trotting.translation: v. 小跑, 急走( trot的现在分词 ); 匆匆忙忙地走

trotty.translation: a. 快步的,疾走的,小跑的, 活泼的,轻快的
